hero.title: Medical devices, end to end.
hero.lead: We turn a need described in the clinic into a device that works in the field, end to end.
hero.visualAlt: The meander mark from the Ahtapot logo, its four arms reaching into mechanics, electronics, firmware and software.

capability.heading: From concept to field, five layers in one team

mekanik.title: Mechanical design
mekanik.sentence: We design enclosures, mechanisms and tolerances with manufacturability in mind from day one, from 3D model to drawing to prototype.
mekanik.caption: 3D CAD model and dimensioning (sample enclosure)
mekanik.alt: A wireframe model of a device enclosure rotating in a CAD workspace, with dimension lines, a model tree and a command line.

elektronik.title: Electronics design
elektronik.sentence: We design the electronics from schematic to board layout, shaping the sensing, power and control stages around what the device needs.
elektronik.caption: Board layout and routing (sample board)
elektronik.alt: Component placement on two copper layers in a board design tool, with routed traces and a design rule check.

gomulu.title: Firmware
gomulu.sentence: We write the software that runs on the device: sensor acquisition, control algorithms and the interlocks that keep it safe.
gomulu.caption: Control firmware, debugging and live data (sample)
gomulu.alt: A control loop stepping through a code editor, a watch panel, a serial terminal and a live temperature plot.

uygulama.title: Application software
uygulama.sentence: From the device screen to the web application, we design user interfaces together with the people who will use them.
uygulama.caption: AhtaPatolog: gallery, review and compare screens
uygulama.alt: Three AhtaPatolog screens: the slide gallery, a tissue section open with annotation tools, and two slides compared side by side.

saha.title: Field support
saha.sentence: Installation, user training, scheduled maintenance and software updates: we support the device throughout its service life.
saha.caption: Devices in the field: remote monitoring, maintenance and updates (illustrative)
saha.alt: Different medical devices in a healthcare facility, with monitoring links to a service centre, calibration and a software update.

product.heading: Products
product.intro: Two products from the same team: a device that works on the lab bench and an imaging application that runs in the browser.
product.modelAlt: A rotatable drawing of the laboratory water bath.

su-banyosu.name: Laboratory water bath
su-banyosu.tagline: Keeps samples at a set temperature. Mechanics, electronics and firmware designed in-house.
su-banyosu.description: A laboratory water bath for heating and incubating samples at a constant temperature. The enclosure, heating control and user interface were all designed by the same team. Change the setpoint in the simulation to see how the device responds.
features: Water level sensor with overflow protection

dijital-patoloji.name: AhtaPatolog
dijital-patoloji.tagline: Viewing, annotation and case management for the pathologist's review.
dijital-patoloji.description: Opens whole-slide images in the browser so the pathologist can examine tissue at high magnification, annotate it and keep cases organised. Diagnostic decisions remain with the pathologist; the software supports the review.
features: Synchronised side-by-side comparison of two slides
screens: Gallery: uploaded slides and their annotation counts
Compare: two slides side by side with synchronised navigation

compare.heading: From microscope to screen
compare.caption: Today, tissue is mostly examined at the microscope, through the eyepiece. AhtaPatolog brings the same section to the screen.
compare.microscopeAlt: An illustrative, circular view of the tissue section as seen through a microscope eyepiece.
compare.digitalAlt: The same tissue section in AhtaPatolog: a digital view with an annotation and a scale bar.

about.heading: About
about.lead: Ahtapot Medical Technologies is a medical device company founded by a physician. Our aim is to design and build in Türkiye the medical devices that are sourced from abroad today.
about.body: We develop the mechanics, electronics and software of each device ourselves. Because the design knowledge stays with us, we never wait on anyone to change a part, add a feature or ship an update.

pillars.title: Designed and built locally
pillars.text: Every layer of the device is designed and prepared for production in Türkiye, reducing dependence on imports for spare parts, maintenance and updates.

pillars.title: A physician's perspective
pillars.text: Requirements are defined by a physician who knows the clinic from the inside. Each device is designed around where it will be used and who will use it.

pillars.title: End-to-end responsibility
pillars.text: From the first drawing to maintenance in the field, we run every stage ourselves, so every matter has a single point of contact.

founder.label: Founder
founder.name: Dr. Mustafa Can Yılmaz
founder.bio: Alongside medicine, works in software, electronics and mechanical design: defines the clinical requirements of each device and takes a hands-on part in its circuit, code and enclosure design.

kvkk.title: Privacy notice (KVKK)
kvkk.legalReviewNote: This is a draft and must be reviewed by legal counsel before publication.
body: This notice is issued by Ahtapot Tıbbi Teknolojileri A.Ş. ("the Company") as data controller under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK").
The name, email address, organisation and message you share through the contact form are processed to assess your request and get back to you.
Your data is not stored in a database. The form is delivered directly as an email and used only to answer your request.
Under Article 11 of KVKK you have the right to learn whether your data is processed and for what purpose, and to request its correction or deletion.
You can send these requests in writing to the address in the contact section.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.legalReviewNote: This is a draft and must be reviewed by legal counsel before publication.
body: This site uses no analytics or tracking cookies.
Information you share through the contact form is not stored in a database; it is only delivered as an email.
There is no third-party advertising or tracking code on this site.
For questions, reach us through the contact section.
